identifierPolicy.versionRule: IDs are immutable. A meaning, hierarchy, bind-pose, payload, or compatibility break creates the next zero-padded revision; display-only text may change in place.

nonHumanoidRequiredChains: one ordered axial chain from body_root to head or primary facing control
one ordered chain per load-bearing limb ending in a contact bone
one semantic attack-origin bone or socket for every anatomy-provided attack origin
tail, wing, tentacle, fin, or extra-limb chains are explicit numbered semantic chains and never mapped by array position
hierarchyRules: root is the only parentless exported bone and is non-deforming.
motion_root is a non-deforming child of root; body_root or pelvis is its child.
No deform bone may be parented to a socket, control, constraint target, or preview helper.
Every exported name is lowercase ASCII snake_case; sides use terminal _l or _r and chain indices use _01, _02, and so on.
Bone identity is its canonical full parent path, never display order or Blender/Unity internal index.
Negative scale, shear, duplicate names, disconnected undeclared roots, zero-length deform bones, and cyclic parenting are invalid.
exportRules: Export root, motion_root, deform bones, and explicitly declared sockets only.
Do not export IK controls, constraints, drivers, preview helpers, cameras, lights, or FBX leaf bones.
Bake constraint results to deform bones at the declared sample rate before export.
Keep sockets non-deforming with identity scale and stable canonical parent paths across every LOD.
Triangulate runtime meshes deterministically and preserve one skeleton signature across mesh and clip files.
Custom properties and animation events travel in the versioned JSON sidecar; FBX take order is not authority.

skeletonProfiles.compatibilityRule: Unity Humanoid mapping, canonical A-pose, scale, contact, socket, deformation, and skeleton-signature gates must all pass; a similar biped silhouette is insufficient.
Retarget only between the same wing, leg, contact, axial-chain, and center-of-mass semantics after proportional and contact tests; never retarget through Unity Humanoid.
Retarget only when contact count, limb order, axial chain, center of mass, gait class, bind-pose disposition, and exact semantic-chain map are declared and validated.

bindPoses.pose: Upright neutral A-pose: feet parallel and grounded, knees and elbows with a visible five-degree preferred bend, arms forty-five degrees below horizontal, palms toward thighs, fingers relaxed, head and eyes forward, pelvis and shoulders level.
bindPoses.jointOrientationRule: Local primary axis points childward; paired limbs mirror orientation and roll; Unity Humanoid Configure Avatar must report a valid mapping and enforced T-pose conversion without changing the stored source bind matrices.
bindPoses.contactRule: Both sole contact planes are at source Z=0 within two millimeters; root and motion_root remain at world origin.
exceptions: Approved asymmetrical anatomy requires a versioned anatomy exception and cannot share this retarget profile until mirrored validation is replaced by explicit per-side evidence.

bindPoses.pose: Lowest-strain anatomy-neutral rest with center of mass supported by every declared load-bearing contact, axial chain readable, appendages separated enough to weight and inspect, and no invented humanoid posture.
bindPoses.jointOrientationRule: Each chain axis points childward with documented bend plane; paired chains mirror roll only when anatomy is actually bilateral.
bindPoses.contactRule: All declared supporting contacts lie on source Z=0 within two millimeters; airborne or aquatic anatomies use a cataloged support datum and anatomy exception.
exceptions: Serpentine, avian flight, aquatic, multiped, and recumbent anatomies require their explicit exception and cannot inherit biped contact assumptions.

bindPoses.pose: Retain the owner-bounded recumbent Slagwhistle source pose; do not unpose it into a standing silhouette that the approved crop does not show.
bindPoses.jointOrientationRule: Preserve the measured source bind matrices while deriving a non-deforming root, motion_root, canonical semantic aliases, and contact map in a new source version.
bindPoses.contactRule: The folded support surface remains grounded at source Z=0; planted-motion contacts are authored from the validated moving pose, not inferred from a quadruped template.
exceptions: This bind pose is incompatible with Unity Humanoid and generic standing-quadruped retargeting.
Standing rest, attack, defeat, or burrow poses require new owner authorization.

hitboxConvention.attachmentRule: Hurtboxes attach by canonical skeleton path or socket_hit_<region>; attack volumes attach by canonical attack-origin socket. Shape, local offset, layer, team filtering, and damage identity live in gameplay data, not mesh or clip files.
hitboxConvention.activationRule: Animation events are request or presentation evidence only. The action sequence and authoritative gameplay phase decide whether a window opens; duplicate, late, missing, or reordered events fail closed without creating a result.

facialProfiles.mobileFallback: Keep eye aim, blink, jaw, sil, aa, ee, oh, fv, and mbp; reduce secondary expression correctives before removing readable speech or focus.
Use authored head, jaw, lid, ear, membrane, or equivalent anatomy bones only when the approved design needs them; do not add a humanoid face rig by default.
Ambient distance uses gaze plus jaw only; conversation distance restores blink and eight visemes.

retargetProfiles.signaturePolicy: Source and target skeleton signatures must match exactly; only mesh, materials, and non-skeletal sockets may vary.
retargetProfiles.translationPolicy: Preserve root and motion_root curves; all deform translation curves require an explicit anatomy exception.
retargetProfiles.scalePolicy: Uniform model scale only and exactly one meter per Unity unit; no per-chain runtime scale compensation.

retargetProfiles.signaturePolicy: A versioned one-to-one semantic chain map is mandatory; contact count, chain order, gait class, and facing reference must match before retargeting.
retargetProfiles.translationPolicy: Retarget rotations and normalized chain extension; preserve target bind translations except root and motion_root trajectory.
retargetProfiles.scalePolicy: Scale stride from declared contact-to-contact and body-length metrics, then pass the two-percent stride and contact tolerances.

retargetProfiles.signaturePolicy: Canonical required bones and sockets must exist, Unity Avatar must be valid, and stored skeleton signature remains an exact binding key even though muscle retargeting is used.
retargetProfiles.translationPolicy: Root and motion_root carry world trajectory; pelvis vertical motion is retained; other translation curves are rejected unless explicitly required by the avatar mapping.
retargetProfiles.scalePolicy: Normalize by measured standing height in meters; no runtime transform scale repair or per-limb nonuniform scaling.

retargetProfiles.signaturePolicy: The remediated Slagwhistle source and every bound clip must share one exact recumbent skeleton signature; no standing, quadruped, or cross-beast retargeting is permitted.
retargetProfiles.translationPolicy: Preserve the recumbent source bind translations and only root/motion_root trajectory; any other translated deform channel requires a new versioned anatomy exception.
retargetProfiles.scalePolicy: Preserve measured source proportions at one meter per Unity unit; no standing-height or limb-length normalization.

rootMotionPolicies.runtimeAuthority: Timeline or cinematic controller owns the isolated shot path; gameplay cinematics still reconcile to a legal gameplay anchor.
rootMotionPolicies.fallback: Block the production shot; previs may use an explicitly labeled proxy.

rootMotionPolicies.runtimeAuthority: Gameplay action owns displacement, collision, and cancellation; animation supplies a normalized trajectory sampled and clamped by the motor.
rootMotionPolicies.fallback: Use an in-place clip and gameplay-owned displacement; never silently apply raw Animator root motion.

rootMotionPolicies.runtimeAuthority: Gameplay interaction alignment owns the actor anchor; optional motion warping is bounded to the declared target transform.
rootMotionPolicies.fallback: Blend to idle at the legal interaction anchor.

rootMotionPolicies.runtimeAuthority: Character motor or server owns movement; a retained source trajectory provides stride evidence and derives the in-place runtime clip.
rootMotionPolicies.fallback: Use the nearest declared speed-set locomotion or idle while movement remains motor-owned.

rootMotionPolicies.runtimeAuthority: NPC schedule and navigation own position; prop alignment uses sockets and interaction anchors.
rootMotionPolicies.fallback: Return to role-appropriate idle without moving the gameplay root.

rootMotionPolicies.runtimeAuthority: Gameplay knockback, control, ragdoll, or defeat state owns displacement and result.
rootMotionPolicies.fallback: Use bounded additive hit response or safe incapacitated pose selected by gameplay state.

rootMotionPolicies.runtimeAuthority: Gameplay skill phase and committed receipt own displacement and result; motion trajectory cannot create a hit, teleport, or status.
rootMotionPolicies.fallback: Use in-place phase clips and gameplay-owned displacement while preserving commit and protected cues.

rootMotionPolicies.runtimeAuthority: Traversal controller validates start, target, collision sweep, cancel rules, and final legal anchor before consuming the authored path.
rootMotionPolicies.fallback: Reject traversal entry and return to locomotion; never snap through blocked geometry.

interruptionPolicy.preCommitRule: Before gameplay commit, cancellation may suppress the result, closes request-only hitbox/VFX/audio windows, emits cancellation once, and blends through a declared cancellation or recovery clip.
interruptionPolicy.postCommitRule: After gameplay commit, the result remains authoritative. Interruption closes presentation windows, emits interruption once, and blends to the highest-priority legal reaction or bounded recovery without replaying commit events.

exceptions.requiredResolution: Use the six-key source-bounded set. Any attack, defeat, burrow, standing-rest, or additional clip requires a new owner decision before authoring.
